Hotel did NOT follow up proactively within 72 hours. This is a major missed opportunity — the guest was clearly interested but didn't book. A simple 'Hi Sarah, just checking if you'd like to proceed?' could have converted this.

dimensions.name: First Impression
dimensions.notes: The website is well-designed with a booking widget and live chat, but room information could be more detailed.

dimensions.name: Response Speed
dimensions.notes: Response times varied; webchat was quick, but email and WhatsApp responses were slower than ideal.

dimensions.name: Personalization
dimensions.notes: Responses were somewhat personalized, but lacked depth in understanding specific needs like conference rates.

dimensions.name: Cross-Channel Consistency
dimensions.notes: Information was mostly consistent across channels, but some details like conference rates were missing.

dimensions.name: Product Knowledge
dimensions.notes: Staff had basic knowledge of rooms and rates but lacked awareness of special deals and extras.

dimensions.name: Proactive Service
dimensions.notes: There was little upselling or suggestion of extras, and no proactive follow-up to close the sale.

dimensions.name: Follow-up
dimensions.notes: No proactive follow-up within 72 hours, missing a key opportunity to convert an interested customer.

dimensions.name: Booking Conversion
dimensions.notes: Efforts to convert the inquiry into a booking were weak, with no urgency or direct booking benefits highlighted.

dimensions.name: Overall Hospitality
dimensions.notes: Interactions were polite and welcoming, but lacked the extra touch to make the customer feel valued.

analysis.executive_summary: The Grand Hotel provides a decent initial experience but misses key opportunities in follow-up and conversion. Improving response times and proactive engagement could significantly boost bookings.
analysis.revenue_impact: Slow email response and lack of follow-up likely lose 20-30% of potential bookings.
analysis.competitive_benchmark: Below average compared to industry standards, particularly in follow-up and conversion efforts.
quick_wins: Implement a follow-up protocol within 24 hours
Train staff on special rates and upselling techniques
